dslRule:
<!id: integer.tostring.primitive>
<!description: Replace Integer.valueOf(i).toString() with Integer.toString(i) to avoid useless wrapper creation.>
<!severity: HINT>
java.lang.Integer.valueOf($x).toString()
=>
java.lang.Integer.toString($x)
;;
summary: Avoids creating unnecessary Integer wrapper objects by directly calling Integer.toString(int).
